name: Eastern Ganga dynasty
short_desc: A dynasty based in Kalinga develops a powerful kingdom along India’s eastern coast.
date_note: Approximate main Kalinga political span, ending with the rise of the Gajapatis; surviving branches continued much later. Sources differ between 1434 and 1436 for the dynastic transition.
notes: Initial article identity, date meaning and source review completed. Summary authored for this catalog; independent claim-specific citations remain open.
